name: Miyamae Shuri
source:
A former professional model now a member and leader of the idol unit "Charm".
Her father is from a rich family of British nobles so while she was brought up to speak politely, beneath the surface she is sharp tongued and offensive. She became an idol as a social study and has absolute confidence in her charm; she has been pampered by men so much that she has lost interest in them.
